<section class="paragraph-id-72691 paragraph--type--basic container--spacer container gutter paragraph container--block-basic">
  <a id="paragraph-72691"></a>
  <header class="hgroup hgroup--center hgroup--limited">
      <div class="hgroup__intro"><p>Just steps from the beach in secluded settings along Pamalican Island’s shore, Amanpulo’s Villas offer consummate privacy. Designed for seamless indoor-to-outdoor living, each one is arranged around an expansive swimming pool with outdoor lounging and dining areas. All villas are staffed by a private chef and butler, and club cars (one per bedroom) invite independent exploration of the island.</p></div>
  </header>
</section>
<section class="paragraph-id-72696 paragraph--type--bulleted-list container--spacer container--text-alignment-default paragraph--bulleted-list container">
  <a id="paragraph-72696"></a>
      <div>
          <header class="field--title hgroup hgroup--limited hgroup--center">
        <h2 class="heading-h">All stays include</h2>
    </header>
    </div>
  <div class="bg-white padded-container padded-container--slim"><ul class="list list--columns list--columns--3"><li>Daily breakfast<br></li><li>Daily afternoon tea at the Clubhouse<br></li><li>In-room refreshments and non-alcoholic beverages <br></li><li>Daily scheduled wellness class (advance booking required)<br></li><li>Daily morning snorkelling trip from the beach (to be provided on a first come, first serve basis)<br></li><li>Access to wellness facilities including yoga pavilion and Pilates studio, steam room, cold plunge pool and fitness centre<br></li><li>Use of selected non-motorised watersports equipment</li></ul></div>
</section>
<section class="paragraph-id-72701 paragraph--type--basic container--spacer container gutter paragraph container--block-basic">
  <a id="paragraph-72701"></a>
  <header class="hgroup hgroup--center hgroup--limited">
      <h2 class="heading-h">Featured offer</h2>
      <div class="hgroup__intro"></div>
  </header>
</section>

      <header class="card__copy--with-accordion hgroup">
        <div>
      <h2 class="heading-h h3">Villa Escape</h2>
      <div class="hgroup__intro"><p>A minimum three-night stay in a beachfront Villa, inclusive of daily breakfast and à la carte dinner at the Clubhouse, Beach Club or in a private dining location of your choice, as well as a private beach BBQ and a cruise around the island.</p></div>
